column1: # ARM DDI 0487 C4.1.94.1..4 Load/store exclusive & atomic CAS/CASP: (word & 0x3f000000) == 0x08000000.
# Enumerates all 4 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 64 combinations of size=0..3, o2=0..1, L=0..1, o1=0..1, o0=0..1
# across 8 register tuples (Rs, Rt2, Rn, Rt) covering STXR/LDXR, STXP/LDXP, LDAR/STLR, LDLAR/STLLR,
# CAS/CASA/CASL/CASAL (Rt2=31), CASP/CASPA/CASPL/CASPAL (Rt2=31, even Rs/Rt incl. 30->ZR), and G62 non-31 Rs/Rt2 (512 rows).
# Reference tool version: Apple LLVM version 21.0.0
# Assembly command: xcrun clang -arch arm64e load_store_exclusive_casp.s -o load_store_exclusive_casp.macho
# Generation command: python3 -I Scripts/acceptance/encoding-table.py generate load_store_exclusive_casp
